title: Unisex Doberman – 80 Pounds of Lap Dog. Hoodie

seo.title: Doberman Hoodie – 80 Pounds of Lap Dog.
seo.description: A funny doberman hoodie for Dobie owners: 80 POUNDS OF LAP DOG. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

80 POUNDS OF LAP DOG. is the doberman hoodie for the owner whose big dog still thinks it fits on a lap, worn on the couch, on walks and as a gift from a family that has been pinned under one.

80 POUNDS OF stacks over two lines across the top and LAP DOG. fills the bottom in huge slab capitals. Between them a black-and-tan Doberman sprawls across the lap of a deadpan man in a green cardigan in a striped armchair, its long legs dangling off both sides while he holds his coffee mug high out of the way.

Navy carries cream and rust tan lettering with a cream edge around the armchair; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this doberman hoodie warm enough for dog walks and cool couches?
Yes. The 80 Pounds of Lap Dog. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for dog walks, couch evenings and cool mornings.

How does the 80 Pounds of Lap Dog. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a Doberman owner?
It is a natural one. Every Dobie owner has been pinned under a dog that thinks it is a lapdog, so it lands with big-dog people, dog-park friends and the family that gave up the armchair. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the armchair scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the 80 Pounds of Lap Dog. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
